app.name: Rayati
app.tagline: Your phone, a pixel in a monumental stadium tifo
app.pitch: Thousands of smartphones in the stands merge into one giant illuminated light show.
welcome.title: Join the Light Show
welcome.lead: Hold up your phone, stadium pitch cameras lock your position in seconds, and your screen joins the grand illuminated tifo.
welcome.how.title: How to participate in 3 steps
welcome.how.1: Smart Optical Calibration: phone screen pulses a Gray Code sequence and camera locks your position with zero manual entry.
welcome.how.2: The light show file downloads once before the match and stays cached offline.
welcome.how.3: At countdown zero, raise your phone with your screen facing the pitch.
welcome.privacy: Zero accounts, zero personal data. Your seat stays stored on your device only.
welcome.offline: Operates 100% offline inside packed stadiums without cellular network.

seat.detected: Seat detected from sticker QR code
seat.footer: If you are sitting in a different seat with friends, scan the new QR now to keep colors crisp.

calibrate.title: Optical Seat Calibration
calibrate.lead: Your screen flashes a high-speed Gray Code pattern. Pitch cameras instantly lock onto your seat coordinates.
calibrate.scanning: Camera scanning in progress… Hold your screen steady towards pitch
calibrate.successLead: Stadium cameras recognized your seat and synchronized your pixel. Screen is now glowing green to confirm.
guide.title: Rayati Supporter Guide
guide.subtitle: How smartphone tifos transform Algerian stadium atmosphere
guide.step1.title: 1. Seat-Printed QR Code
guide.step1.desc: Every stadium seat features a rugged QR badge. A single scan configures your exact section, row, and seat without typing.
guide.step2.title: 2. Optical Computer Vision Calibration
guide.step2.desc: Before kick-off, your phone emits an imperceptible Gray Code flash sequence. Pitched cameras adjust your position if you swapped seats.
guide.step3.title: 3. Instant Green & Haptic Confirmation
guide.step3.desc: As soon as your location is confirmed, your screen turns a glowing emerald green with double vibration feedback.
guide.step4.title: 4. Screen Facing the Pitch
guide.step4.desc: When the timer strikes zero, hold your phone high towards the pitch. Thousands of screens unite in a giant animated Algerian flag.
guide.offlineBadge: Zero network lag: Operates 100% offline, unaffected by 50,000-fan cellular overload
